hello.note: The polite greeting for most of the day. With friends: Cześć!

please.note: Proszę also means 'here you are'. To ask for something: Poproszę … (I'd like …).

no.note: Nie also makes verbs negative: nie wiem (I don't know).

sorry.note: Polish uses przepraszam for both 'sorry' and 'excuse me'.

excuse_me.note: To a woman: Przepraszam panią. Plain Przepraszam works too.

good_morning.note: Same as hello: Polish has no separate morning greeting, Dzień dobry is used until evening.

how_are_you.note: To a woman: Jak się pani ma? Casual: Jak się masz? or Co słychać?

whats_your_name.note: To a woman: Jak się pani nazywa? Casual: Jak masz na imię?

my_name_is.note: For just your first name: Mam na imię …

nice_to_meet_you.note: To a woman: Miło mi panią poznać. Short and very common: Miło mi.

where_from.note: To a woman: Skąd pani jest? Casual: Skąd jesteś?

im_from.note: The country changes form after z: z Anglii, z Kanady, z Niemiec.

speak_english.note: To a woman: Czy mówi pani po angielsku?

what.note: If you didn't catch something, Słucham? or Proszę? is politer than Co?

where_bathroom.note: Toilet doors are often marked with a circle (women) and a triangle (men).

can_you_help.note: To a woman: Czy może mi pani pomóc?

one.note: With feminine nouns: jedna; with neuter nouns: jedno.

three.note: Roughly 'tshih' (i as in 'bit'): after t, rz sounds like sh.

water.note: Still: woda niegazowana; sparkling: woda gazowana.

coffee.note: With milk: kawa z mlekiem; black: czarna kawa.

bill_please.note: Also: Czy mogę prosić o rachunek?

enjoy_meal.note: The usual reply: Dziękuję, nawzajem! (thanks, you too).

hotel.note: Same word as in English, but stressed on the first syllable: HO-tel.

train_station.note: Usually just dworzec. Bus station: dworzec autobusowy.

want_to_go.note: Politer: Chciałbym pojechać do … (a woman: Chciałabym). The place changes form: do Krakowa.

one_ticket.note: Full fare: bilet normalny; discounted (students, seniors): bilet ulgowy.

cheaper.note: To a woman: Czy ma pani coś tańszego? Or simply: Czy jest coś tańszego?

id_like_this.note: Also common: Wezmę to (I'll take it).

cash.note: The answer to 'Kartą czy gotówką?' (card or cash?). The noun itself is gotówka.

big.note: With feminine nouns: duża; with neuter nouns: duże.

small.note: With feminine nouns: mała; with neuter nouns: małe.

good_evening.note: Only a greeting. When leaving, say Do widzenia or Dobranoc.

see_you_later.note: Casual: Na razie! or Do później!

call_police.note: Emergency number: 112 (the police number 997 also works).

allergic.note: Also: Jestem uczulony na … (a woman: uczulona).

be_careful.note: To a friend: Uważaj! Shouted warnings and signs: Uwaga!

i_like_it.note: For food and drink: Smakuje mi.

dont_like_it.note: For food and drink: Nie smakuje mi.

im_happy.note: A woman says: Jestem szczęśliwa. For everyday 'I'm glad': Cieszę się.

welcome.note: A single host often says: Witam! or Zapraszam! (come on in).

congratulations.note: For birthdays and holidays: Wszystkiego najlepszego!
